decisions.statement: A refusal is the caller's mistake unless the caller names another code.
A refusal naming one reason is the refusal of a list holding that reason alone.
A refusal built from reasons alone reports nothing.
A report answered with no refusal is the answer of a command that worked.
A report is answered beside its refusals where a write came before the refusal.
Only that answer carries a report and refusals at once.
A value answered as JSON is one line of JSON.
A value answered as JSON carries the refusals and the code its caller names.
A value answered as JSON alone carries no refusal and the code of work done.
A value answered as indented JSON is one report line to each line of it.
Those lines are one value broken up rather than one value to a line.
A fault with a code of its own is answered with that code.
A fault with no code of its own is answered as operational.
A fault is answered as its message and where that fault was thrown.
A fault carrying no frame is answered as its message alone.
Work is handed a list to name each thing on as that thing is done.
A fault is answered with what that list holds, reported and named in the refusal.
A fault with nothing on that list is answered as the fault alone.
The work a test hands in to name some writes and then throw is built here for every test to reach.
An answer refusing after a write names what was written beside that refusal.
An answer refusing with nothing written is left as that answer was.
An answer refusing nothing is left as that answer was, whatever was written.
A refusal names what was written where the report already carries it.
That list holds what outlives the run rather than every step the run took.
Work owes that list a name from its second durable write onward.
Work making one durable write owes nothing, one write being whole or not made.
A write made by something the work calls is the work's own write.
A work whose writes hide inside what it calls has its list checked as filled.
Writing seams handed in as a named record would make a work's writes countable.
Which work owes nothing is judged by reading it, command by command.
The sentence naming what that list holds is built here for every refusal to reach.
A line keyed by a name carries that name, a tab and what the name holds.
A name holding nothing at all is a line, and a name holding no value is none.
Nothing here prints.
Nothing here reads the words a command was called with.
A fault thrown outside every command is answered as unclassified.
Such a refusal opens with the name the call was made by.

definition: the answer a command hands back, and the code that answer has
